outlook.statement: Looking ahead, we remain confident that our innovation-driven approach, customer-centric focus, and sustainable practices will drive our future growth. Together, we are committed to building a stronger organization that creates long-term value for all stakeholders.
Your Directors are hopeful that the Company may continue showing better performance in coming year.

The Company is performing gradually better and it is also expected to perform better in terms of profitability in the years to come. However, it might be difficult in the present scenario to predict profits in measurable terms.

The Indian plastic piping industry is expected to witness approximately 8% volume growth in FY 2026-27, supported by recovery in housing and agriculture demand, infrastructure spending and increasing penetration of organised players.
The Indian plastic pipe market is expected to grow at an impressive CAGR of 10.3% from 2022 to 2027, reaching a valuation of $10.9 billion.

Continued investment in programmes such as the Jal Jeevan Mission, PMAY, PM GatiShakti and other infrastructure initiatives is expected to support the development of water-management and infrastructure networks and contribute to the long-term growth prospects of the polymer piping industry.
Policy initiatives like AMRUT 2.0 and Smart Cities Mission create huge demand for commercial and real estate.

Sectors focusing more positively year on year include Irrigation, Real Estate and Urban Infrastructure and various government schemes like Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana and boosting in micro irrigation projects and agriculture.
Raw material prices are slightly improving and shall develop a positive and growth impact in both revenue and operational outlook.
